<h2>Metadata analysis</h2>
<h4>Date interval for each individual</h4>
```{r}
ROOT_PROJ <- "/home/cactus/Documents/Oceano/M2/LOCEAN/Weddell_seal_fluo"
DATA_FOLDER <- "oceanographic_data"
DEPLOY_FOLDER <- "wd11"
DATA_PATH <- file.path(ROOT_PROJ, DATA_FOLDER, DEPLOY_FOLDER)

nc_files <- list.files(DATA_PATH, pattern = "\\.nc$", full.names = TRUE)
ranges_list <- list()

for (nc_file in nc_files) {
  nc_data <- nc_open(nc_file)
  juld <- ncvar_get(nc_data, "JULD")

  dateTime <- as.POSIXct(juld * 86400, origin = "1950-01-01", tz = "UTC")
  dateTime <- round(dateTime, units = "mins")

  ranges_list[[basename(nc_file)]] <- range(dateTime, na.rm = TRUE)
  nc_close(nc_data)
}

for (file_name in names(ranges_list)) {
  cat("\nFichier:", file_name, "\n")
  print(ranges_list[[file_name]])
}
```
<h4>Number of profiles per individual</h4>
```{r}
ROOT_PROJ <- "/home/cactus/Documents/Oceano/M2/LOCEAN/Weddell_seal_fluo"
DATA_FOLDER <- "oceanographic_data"
DEPLOY_FOLDER <- "wd20"
DATA_PATH <- file.path(ROOT_PROJ, DATA_FOLDER, DEPLOY_FOLDER)

nc_files <- list.files(DATA_PATH, pattern = "\\.nc$", full.names = TRUE)
profiles_list <- list()

for (nc_file in nc_files)
{
  nc_data <- nc_open(nc_file)

  profiles_data <- ncvar_get(nc_data, "LIGHT")

  num_profiles <- dim(profiles_data)[2]

  profiles_list[[basename(nc_file)]] <- num_profiles

  nc_close(nc_data)
}

for (file_name in names(profiles_list)) {
  cat("\nFichier:", file_name, "\n")
  cat("Nombre de profils de lumière:", profiles_list[[file_name]], "\n")
}

```
#Distribution temporelle des profils par depl.
```{r}
library(ncdf4)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

ROOT_PROJ <- "/home/cactus/Documents/Oceano/M2/LOCEAN/Weddell_seal_fluo"
DATA_FOLDER <- "oceanographic_data"
#deployments <- c("wd10", "wd11", "wd12", "wd13", "wd19", "wd20", "wd31")
deployments <- c("wd11", "wd12", "wd20", "wd31") # winter
#deployments <- c("wd10", "wd13", "wd19") # summer

# Dataframe pour stocker tout
all_profiles <- data.frame()

for (DEPLOY_FOLDER in deployments) {
  DATA_PATH <- file.path(ROOT_PROJ, DATA_FOLDER, DEPLOY_FOLDER)
  nc_files <- list.files(DATA_PATH, pattern = "\\.nc$", full.names = TRUE)

  for (nc_file in nc_files) {
    nc_data <- nc_open(nc_file)
    juld <- ncvar_get(nc_data, "JULD")
    nc_close(nc_data)

    dateTime <- as.POSIXct(juld * 86400, origin = "1950-01-01", tz = "UTC")
    dateTime <- round(dateTime, units = "mins")

    # Création d'une entrée par profil (valeur de JULD)
    profiles <- data.frame(
      dateTime = dateTime,
      deployment = DEPLOY_FOLDER,
      file = basename(nc_file)
    )

    all_profiles <- bind_rows(all_profiles, profiles)
  }
}

ggplot(all_profiles, aes(x = dateTime, y = deployment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution temporelle des profils par déploiement",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Déploiement") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"))


```

# Nombre de profils par individu
```{r}
library(ncdf4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

all_profiles <- readRDS("/home/cactus/Documents/Oceano/M2/LOCEAN/Weddell_seal_fluo/oceanographic_data_corrected/all_deployment.rds")

# Extraire le déploiement, puis compter les profils uniques (1 par profile_id)
profile_counts <- all_profiles %>%
  distinct(seal_id, profile_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # 1 ligne par profil
  mutate(deployment = sub("-.*$", "", seal_id)) %>%
  group_by(seal_id, deployment) %>%
  summarise(n_profiles = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Affichage
ggplot(profile_counts, aes(x = seal_id, y = n_profiles, fill = deployment)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of profiles by individual",
    x = "",
    y = "Number of profiles"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
# Nombre de profils par mois par depl.
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

# Lire les données
all_profiles <- readRDS("/home/cactus/Documents/Oceano/M2/LOCEAN/Weddell_seal_fluo/oceanographic_data_corrected/all_deployment.rds")

# Extraire les profils uniques
profiles_unique <- all_profiles %>%
  distinct(seal_id, profile_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(
    deployment = sub("-.*$", "", seal_id),                                 
    month_label = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
  )

# Compter les profils par mois et par déploiement
monthly_counts <- profiles_unique %>%
  group_by(deployment, month_label) %>%
  summarise(n_profiles = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Ordonner les mois
monthly_counts$month_label <- factor(monthly_counts$month_label,
                                     levels = month.abb, ordered = TRUE)

# Graphe final
ggplot(monthly_counts, aes(x = month_label, y = n_profiles)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~deployment, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Monthly number of profiles by deployment", x = "", y = "Number of profiles"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 300)) +   # fixe le y
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

```
## Temporal distribution of profiles
```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(ggridges)
library(forcats)

# Charger les données
all_profiles <- readRDS("/home/cactus/Documents/Oceano/M2/LOCEAN/Weddell_seal_fluo/oceanographic_data_corrected/all_deployment.rds")

# Préparer les profils
profiles_unique <- all_profiles %>%
  distinct(seal_id, profile_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = year(date),
    deployment = sub("-.*$", "", seal_id)
  ) %>%
  group_by(deployment) %>%
  mutate(
    seal_id_local = factor(seal_id)  # simple facteur alphabétique
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Graphique
ggplot(profiles_unique, aes(x = date, y = seal_id_local, fill = seal_id)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    scale = 1, alpha = 0.8, color = "black", rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  facet_wrap(~year, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b", date_breaks = "2 months") +   # Jan, Feb, ...
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )

```
